final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT store_id AS c1, COUNT(*) AS c2 FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c2) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, CAST(s1.c2 AS REAL) / s2.c1 AS c3 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s3) SELECT s3.c1, s3.c2, s3.c3, CAST(s3.c2 AS REAL) / s4.c1 AS c4 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.c1 IS NOT NULL
